data.text:
EDSA-ORTIGAS FLYOVER SOUTHBOUND OPEN TO LIGHT VEHICLES

LOOK: Authorities reopen the EDSA-Ortigas flyover southbound to light vehicles following a temporary closure after a bus caught fire Friday evening.

The Department of Public Works and Highways has imposed a 20 km/h speed limit as retrofitting and repair works continue on affected portions of the interchange.

Authorities conducted load testing before reopening the flyover at 4 a.m. on Monday, April 27. 

📷 MMDA, DPWH National Capital Region Authority/Facebook
